verdict.rationale: PostHog ships its own natural-language surfaces: you can tag @PostHog in Slack to ship a fix, answer a data question or edit content, and its official MCP server lets agents read and write across its products. A hands-on report shows real limits, though: the built-in LLM couldn't create a cohort from a SQL query, and the text input became very slow after two prompts. missing for 10: in-depth docs on the in-app natural-language assistant's scope, evidence that it covers all core operations (e.g. cohort creation), and independent corroboration of reliable performance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Tag @PostHog in any Slack thread to ship a fix, answer a data question, or edit content – without leaving the conversation.
Once connected, your agent can read and write across PostHog's products.
